name: Concord Deserter
desc: Well trained, desperate, and out of options.

intro: A deserter in a stripped Concord uniform brings up a service rifle. Their hands are steady, and their eyes aren't.
hit: A disciplined burst walks across your chest.
The deserter fires from cover, just like the manual says, and it works.
miss: Rounds chew the wall beside you.
The deserter fires twice, and misses twice, and swears in perfect Fleet standard.
crit: A perfect shot. Somebody taught this person very well.
defeated: The deserter sits down against the wall, looking almost relieved.
